products.name: Floral Story
products.description: Carefully shaped floral clay hair clip with pastel blush accents, soft lavender hues, and a resilient alligator grip. Perfect for daily campus wear, Sunday brunch, or clean half-up hairstyles.

products.name: Garden Pop
products.tagline: A little color for your everyday
products.description: Bright and cheerful handcrafted botanical petals molded with our proprietary lightweight non-toxic clay. Adds an effortless, artsy Filipina spark to your uniform or casual fit.

products.name: Bloom in Bloom
products.description: Intricately layered floral petals and delicate sculpted leaves. Baked for lightweight strength and coated with a protective satin seal that withstands tropical humidity.

products.name: Pastel Sampaguita Blossom
products.description: Inspired by the national flower of the Philippines with a modern pastel lilac twist. Hand-sculpted petal by petal with our signature velvety clay finish.

products.name: Harana Sweetheart Duo Set
products.description: Set of two complementary clay clips (1 Gamay 3.2cm for front side-swept hair + 1 Dako 5.5cm for full ponytail hold). Includes keepsake organza gift pouch and care card.

hero.title: Wear your
hero.description: Handmade clay hair clips made to celebrate creativity, femininity, and your own unique style. Hulma ng Sining, Likha ng Filipina.

story.heading: Not just a hair clip.
story.paragraph1: MAYUMI is a Filipino handmade hair accessory brand that turns clay into small pieces of wearable art. Every design begins with an idea, shaped by hand and finished with care.
story.paragraph2: Inspired by creativity, culture, and contemporary femininity, we make accessories that invite you to express yourself in your own way—one colorful detail at a time. Proudly student-founded and operated in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan.

values.title: Handmade with Heart
values.desc: Every single piece is mixed, sculpted, detailed, and cured by our team of five artisans.

values.title: Expressive & Vibrant
values.desc: Play with cheerful pastels, blooming petals, and silhouettes that complement everyday school or workday fits.

values.title: Filipina-Inspired
values.desc: Celebrating local craftsmanship and youthful creativity, designed to be accessible and student-budget friendly.

craft.heading: Shaped slowly.
craft.description: Our process starts with design planning and material preparation, then moves through shaping, detailing, drying, finishing, assembly, and quality checking. Each step helps bring the idea to life.

steps.title: Design & Shape
steps.desc: Color conditioning our custom non-toxic clay, slicing precise slabs, and hand-sculpting each petal and leaf.

steps.title: Detail & Finish
steps.desc: Adding textural veining, curing for lightweight durability, and sealing with a protective water-resistant coat.

steps.title: Check & Prepare
steps.desc: Reinforcing secure anti-snag metal clips, inspecting under light, and packaging in eco-friendly custom backing cards.

craft.note: MAYUMI is designed around handcrafted production, thoughtful details, and rigorous quality checking before products reach our customers.

pricing.title: Simple, student-friendly
pricing.lead: Every MAYUMI clip is shaped by hand from our own non-toxic clay, and priced fairly so everyone can wear a piece of art.
pricing.gamayDesc: Ideal for subtle bangs, accent styling, school uniform days, and half-up fringes.
pricing.dakoDesc: Bold statement looks, thicker hair hold, event styling, and standout casual fits.
pricing.note: MAYUMI Sets pair coordinated clips that mix and match. Custom color palettes available upon request.

features.title: 100% Handcrafted
features.desc: Each piece is hand-shaped, so no two clips are ever identical.

features.title: Non-Toxic Custom Clay
features.desc: Gentle on skin and hair, odorless, and durable for daily wear.

features.title: Lightweight Alligator Clip
features.desc: Stays in place without pulling or snagging your hair strands.

features.title: Easy to Pair
features.desc: Colors that match casual OOTDs, school uniforms, and event attire.

popup.locationDesc: Minuyan, San Jose del Monte City, Bulacan (near City College of San Jose del Monte). We also set up regular booths at school bazaars, community fairs, and weekend creative markets.
popup.hoursNote: Store hours may adjust during school exam weeks and special bazaar pop-up appearances. Follow our social pages for weekly event announcements!
popup.nextEventDetails: Catch our live clay sculpting demo and exclusive bazaar-only clip designs this weekend at Minuyan Commercial Center!
orderSteps: Browse our collection and pick your favorite design and clip size (Gamay or Dako).
Reserve your clip through our online order drawer or message us on Instagram / Facebook.
Choose whether to pick up at our Minuyan SJDM booth or arrange local delivery.
Settle payment via GCash, Maya, or Cash on Pickup/Meet-up.
We prepare, hand-inspect, and package your unique MAYUMI clay piece with care.

quote.sub: A small celebration of Filipino creativity, craftsmanship, and sisterhood.

contact.heading: Found a piece that feels
contact.description: For product questions, custom design inquiries, wholesale school giveaways, or updates about upcoming pop-up appearances, send us an email or message the MAYUMI team.
contact.footnote: MAYUMI is proudly owned and operated by five Filipina business partners: Maria Katrina Burdeos, Rosa Vilma Gabitan, Mary Jane Judilla, Jennifer Nicolas, and Resha Labanada. Salamat for supporting local handmade Filipino creativity!
